summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K disclosing a new share buyback program approved by its Board on 29 July 2026, following ECB authorization received 16 July 2026. The program authorizes buybacks up to EUR 2 billion over one year, with a first tranche of EUR 1 billion (maximum 483,221,729 shares) running from 5 August to no earlier than 14 September and no later than 9 October 2026, extendable to 23 October. Purchases will occur on Spanish and European trading venues, managed independently by HSBC Continental Europe and broker Kepler Cheuvreux. Shares will be cancelled, reducing share capital and returning capital to shareholders; the full amount is deducted from CET1.
